purpose: Convert screenshot judgment into project-independent screen-space and form-hierarchy constraints.

rules.principle: A non-story foreground object must not divide the primary subject silhouette.
A readable subject needs a minimum frame margin and room for the action vector.
Shot scale is an interval, not a fixed lens percentage.
Added modeling detail must read as part of the parent form instead of a floating block.
More parts are not more quality; added detail has a screen-space coverage budget.
Primary, secondary, and tertiary forms must occupy visibly different scale bands.
A face is a landmark hierarchy, not a count of plates.
